page.layout: One page of text in one column; a handwritten annotation in the left margin (not printed, not transcribed); a catchword-like word "gnos" at the lower right is the last word of the text line, so it is part of the running text. Running head at top centre; page number at top left.

main_text.p: Iosue ad castra in Gilgal, dicendo, Ne cōtrahas manus tuas à seruis tuis: ascéde ad nos citò, & serua nos, atque auxiliare nobis: congregati enim sunt contra nos omnes reges Amorrhæi habitantes in monte.
7 Ascendit itaque Iosue de Gilgal, ipse, & vniuersus populus bellator cū eo, omnes potentes viribus.
8 Dixit autem Iehoua ad Iosue, Ne timeas ab eis: in manum enim tuā tradidi eos, nec consistet quisquam ex eis in conspectu tuo.
9 Et venit ad eos Iosue repente: tota enim nocte ascendit de Gilgal.
10 Et contriuit eos Iehoua coram Israel, percusítque eos plaga magna in Gibeon, & persequutus est eos per viam ascensus Beth-horō, & percusit eosusque Azecah, & usque Makedah.
11 Dum autem fugerent à facie Israel, & essent in descensu Beth-oron, Iehoua demisit super eos lapides magnos

page.notes: The left margin carries a manuscript annotation in ink, not printed; omitted. Some words are underlined in ink, which is not print. The word "gnos" at the foot right is printed as a continuation of the line "magnos"; transcribed as printed. Word "eosvsque" appears as printed with a joined form; read as "eosusque" with doubt. Possible doubtful readings: "eosvsque" (line 10).
